name: three-ws-docs-rerank
description: Hand-written retrieval questions for the knowledge rerank eval (scripts/nvidia-rerank-eval.mjs). Each question was written by reading one chunk produced by the production chunker and paraphrasing what it answers without reusing its heading or distinctive wording; `relevant` names that chunk (and any other chunk that answers it equally). The corpus is every 12th top-level docs/*.md at `corpus_commit`, kept when 2 KB to 60 KB, chunked with api/_lib/knowledge-chunker.js (kind docx): 652 chunks from 49 docs, so every other chunk is a distractor. Chunk ids are <path>#<chunk_index> at that commit.
